item.title: People protest against ICE in West Michigan
item.description: People of all ages showed up in downtown Grand Rapids to protest United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement action.

item.title: Muskegon County commissioner dies after cancer battle
item.description: Commissioner Darrell Paige died Jan. 31, the county confirmed in a social media post Sunday afternoon. His wife, Michelle Loyd Paige attributed his death to a 19 month-long battle with cancer.

item.title: Horses rescued after falling through ice at golf course pond
item.description: Four horses were rescued after falling into an icy pond in Calhoun County Sunday morning.

item.title: World of Winter events resume as snow pauses
item.description: Now that the snow has paused, World of Winter events that were postponed are starting up again — like a sound bath and meditation.

item.title: Pistons hand Nets loss in most lopsided win in team history
item.description: Jalen Duren had 21 points and 10 rebounds after being added to the All-Star Game on Sunday night as an Eastern Conference reserve, and the Detroit Pistons routed the Brooklyn Nets 130-77 in the most-lopsided victory in franchise history.

item.title: Grand Rapids spot named in '100 Most Romantic Restaurants' study
item.description: It can always be tricky trying to figure out the perfect date for Valentine's Day. Luckily, OpenTable has found the answers for you, having officially named the 100 most romantic restaurants across the U.S.

item.title: Person falls, injures leg while on Lake Michigan ice shelf
item.description: A person was taken to the hospital after falling on Lake Michigan's ice shelf in South Haven Sunday afternoon, first responders say.

item.title: Kennedy Center to close for 2 years for renovations in July, Trump says, after performers' backlash
item.description: President Donald Trump said Sunday he will move to close Washington’s Kennedy Center performing arts center for two years starting in July for construction, his latest proposal to upturn the storied venue since returning to the White House.

item.title: Person shot in Greenville, airlifted to hospital, dispatch says
item.description: A person was airlifted to the hospital after being shot in Greenville Sunday night, dispatch says.

item.title: Vigil honors family of shooting victims, urges action on domestic violence
item.description: It was another night of mourning and remembrance for the Grand Rapids community as people once again gathered to honor the lives of Jacqueline Neill and her two teenage sons, Cameron and Michael Kilpatrick, who were shot and killed last week.
